set.body:
PRD DOC-R3, A-12. Delivered: curated site-docs mdoc/Laika site, build.sbt docs/tlSite task, generated CI step, executable first-study/recording examples and tools/check-docs.py baseline-entry-point mapping. Do not rebuild the site framework. The original claim about sibling libraries is irrelevant and removed.

Remaining work, in order:
1. Inventory every user-facing Scala example in site-docs, README and linked current guides; map each to mdoc or an executed named test/main. Distinguish historical design notes and explicitly marked pseudocode. A prose link or presence in the migration matrix is not execution coverage.
2. Migrate residual runnable examples and add CI enforcement against newly unverified fences/linked example files. Keep scientific assertions, failures and units in the examples, not only successful compilation. Correct the stale R-required template recommendation with eyesim-template; until native fitting lands, clearly label that route as legacy optional interop, not the supported native workflow.
3. Build docs/tlSite from the reviewed source, validate navigation/links and review rendered desktop/mobile pages and code overflow. Follow repository browser ownership policy; local rendered HTML inspection is distinct from hosted publication.
4. Record the exact candidate SHA, build/check receipts and hosted CI run when the candidate is published. A local build alone is not hosted CI evidence. Deployment is not required by this ticket and must not be invented as a prerequisite.

Acceptance: a finite maintained example inventory has no unexplained executable gaps; documented routes execute through public APIs with expected scientific outputs; generated workflow remains reproducible and rendered review has a receipt. doc-scaladoc owns API reference completeness; v-coverage owns all public entry points. New scientific breadth stays under its method ticket. Review: docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md.
set.title: Finish executable documentation coverage and rendered review
